senses.zh_definition: 戈文德：南亚传统中的人名，与 Govinda 这一姓名形式有关；在具体文本中指名为 Govind 的人。
senses.en_definition: A personal name associated with the South Asian name Govinda; its bearer must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang berkaitan dengan bentuk nama Govinda dalam tradisi Asia Selatan; orang yang dirujuk ditentukan melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专名，不是表示职业或身份类别的普通马来语名词。相关姓名也有宗教用法，但不能仅凭姓名推断持名者的信仰。以下是自然称呼和名词组合示例，并非经过语料统计的高频搭配。本条释义为编写说明；status 沿用指定格式，不代表 DBP 收录认证。[姓名及相关形式](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Govind)。

etymology.historical_story: Govind is associated with Govinda, a Sanskrit name with religious and personal uses. Sanskrit lexical tradition connects Govinda with cattle and finding, while devotional traditions associate the name with Krishna. These associations belong to the name's wider history; they do not establish any individual bearer's religion, ancestry or preferred interpretation. [Sanskrit lexical sources](https://www.wisdomlib.org/definition/govinda), [Govind](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Govind).
